keepSeparate.reason: RMSE and MSE are different metrics with different scale and mathematical definitions.
Weak and variational formulations can overlap in some methods but are not universally identical concepts.
SIREN is an architecture/representation using sinusoidal activations; generic sine activation is not itself the SIREN architecture.
The activation taxonomy's SIREN-style sinusoidal activation is a component record, while SIREN itself is an architecture/representation.
F042 deliberately combines automatic and numerical differentiation and is not identical to pure automatic differentiation.
Adaptive Swish has trainable/adaptive behavior and is not identical to fixed Swish.
Generic Leaky ReLU must remain distinct from the slope-0.1 parameterized variant.
Generic Leaky ReLU must remain distinct from the alpha-0.2 parameterized variant.
Different negative-slope parameterizations are distinct activation records.
The generic Ecosystem item does not specify the slope-0.1 variant.
The generic Ecosystem item does not specify the alpha-0.2 variant.
The generic Ecosystem Swish item does not imply adaptive Swish.
This Ecosystem object is explicitly in the activation-function group, not the architecture group.
This Ecosystem object is explicitly in the neural-architecture group, not the activation taxonomy identity.
F053 formulates the SIREN representation network, not merely its sinusoidal activation component.
Vector L-infinity error and scalar maximum absolute error can coincide in scalar cases but are not universally identical definitions.
Physics-residual RMS and PDE-residual MSE differ by the square-root operation and must remain separate.
A generic conservation imbalance is not identical to a mass-specific conservation error.
A generic conservation imbalance is not identical to an energy-specific conservation error.
A generic conservation imbalance is not identical to a momentum-specific conservation error.
Accuracy-matched speedup is a specialized measure with an accuracy threshold, whereas generic speedup is broader.
